name: Alleima AB (publ)
summary: Alleima AB (publ) operates globally as a producer and distributor of specialized stainless steel products, advanced alloys, and industrial heating solutions. Its extensive catalog features items such as tubular goods, solid bars and billets, heating elements and related technologies, various strip steels (including coated variants), and precision wires for medical applications. These materials and solutions cater to a broad spectrum of industries, finding use in products like seamless stainless tubing, industrial heating components, medical device wiring, and high-grade precision strip steels. Additionally, the company supplies comprehensive electrical heating systems and resistance materials. Alleima was founded in 1862 and is headquartered in Sandviken, Sweden.
